posts.text:
No one should have to justify who they love or how they express themselves.

I’m grateful to have worked alongside LGBTQ+ advocates to make Maryland a safe haven for their community. Together, we’ve passed the Trans Health Care Equity Act, decriminalized HIV, and doubled funding for hate crime prevention – and we’re not done!
posts.summary: Celebrates LGBTQ+ protections and expanded trans healthcare funding

posts.text:
The Trump Administration does not get to pick and choose who has the right to be an American.

For generations, the promise that every child born on American soil is an American citizen has been woven into the very fabric of our Constitution. 

Today's ruling affirms that promise.
posts.summary: Defends birthright citizenship against Trump Administration challenge

posts.text:
Today, we honor the five Capital Gazette staffers killed in an attack on their newsroom eight years ago. 

Today is a reminder that we must protect the freedom of the press. A free press allows our journalists to report the truth and serve our democracy by keeping residents informed about our government.
posts.summary: Affirms importance of press freedom and journalist protection

I’m disappointed in the Supreme Court’s decision to betray our Haitian and Syrian neighbors by allowing the Trump Administration to remove their protected status. 

Haitian and Syrian Americans are a crucial part of our nation’s fabric and play an important role in Maryland’s communities. They’ve spent years in our country building their lives, starting families, contributing to our communities and our economy.
